'''Duro''' was an individual who was one of the former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Fy-Tor-Ana]]'s, now known as Solace, trusted assistants. Duro was speculated by Solace to have been bribed or threatened by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], to give up where the place of [[Solace (location)|Solace]] was, allowing the Empire to invade and destroy the place of Solace. Additionally, he was the one person aside from Solace herself to be aware of the warning system in the place of Solace, causing the former Jedi Solace to continue speculating that he must've turned off the warning system to not alert the people of Solace to the Empire's attack. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Oryon]] agreed with Solace's theory, having seen Duro being given a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] to escape from the invasion.<ref name="Death on Naboo" />
==Behind the scenes==
Duro first appeared in the [[2006]] book ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo|Last of the Jedi: Death On Naboo]]''.<ref name="Death on Naboo" /> [[Donal (Coruscant)|Donal]], another one of Solace's assistants, received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' which refers to Donal being the one that Solace speculated was a double agent, instead of Duro. In fact, Duro didn't receive an entry in the book.<ref name="TCCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Donal did not appear in Death on Naboo, and his entry in the Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia does not reflect the events stated in Death on Naboo.<ref name="Death on Naboo" />
